statement.local_exact_result: For every finite contiguous source-order block partition, B=mu*1+C with sum(C)=0 and R=sum(B)=J*mu. Hence the prefix endpoint level is exactly the mean coordinate. For any p>=1, Holder gives |R| <= J^(1-1/p)||B||_p (including |R|<=J||B||_infinity).
statement.route_classification: A centered block statistic computed only from C is a genuinely non-extremal internal representation but leaves the exact mean coordinate outside the statistic; endpoint/Li gluing therefore needs an additional target-domain mean-versus-fluctuation theorem or separate mean control, plus complement control. Conversely, a raw level-sensitive block norm strong enough to control the relevant scale directly bounds the prefix endpoint and cannot be presumed a weaker local surrogate.
statement.target_domain_strictness: CANNOT_CHECK: no arithmetic DifferenceWitness or theorem establishes how much information about the fixed zeta block mean is determined by centered fluctuations. Ambient common-level shifts demonstrate only representation-level nonidentification.

proof: Finite block additivity in natural order gives R=sum_{j=1}^J B_j.
With mu=J^{-1}sum_j B_j and C_j=B_j-mu, sum_j C_j=sum_j B_j-J mu=0 and R=J mu.
For 1<=p<infinity, Holder applied to <B,1> gives |sum_j B_j|<=||B||_p ||1||_q=J^(1/q)||B||_p=J^(1-1/p)||B||_p; p=infinity gives |sum B_j|<=J||B||_infinity.
Thus the sum functional annihilates the centered subspace and depends only on the mean coordinate. This is an exact finite-algebra statement on the actual target-derived block vector.
No step infers that arbitrary common-level shifts are arithmetically realizable; therefore the result stops at representation/gluing classification rather than target-domain nonimplication.

falsification.counterexample_first: Checked the identities and Holder bounds on 1,400 hostile/random finite block vectors as regression calibration; this computation is not proof authority.
falsification.revision_trigger: A source-bound all-index theorem coupling the actual zeta block mean to centered fluctuations strongly enough for the Li consumer would reopen this route and revise the gluing diagnosis.

successor: Rotate from strict-cut/block-statistic variants to a freshly frozen mollifier / inverse-approximation root-bridge fibre unless a target-domain mean/fluctuation coupling theorem is located.
